categories.name: Welcome
categories.title: Welcome
categories.text:
Good to have you here.

Read the rules before you play - they are short, and they are enforced.

Everything else you need is in the list on the left.

categories.name: Rules
categories.title: Server Rules
categories.text:
The short version: play as a team, talk to people, do not ruin someone else's evening.

Pick a rule on the left for the detail.

entries.name: Teamplay
entries.title: § 1 - Teamplay
entries.text:
§ 1
Play as a team

This is a milsim, not a deathmatch. Kills are not the score.

Stealing vehicles or supplies from your own side

Leaving wounded teammates behind without a word

Going off alone and calling it reconnaissance

entries.name: Teamkilling
entries.title: § 2 - Teamkilling
entries.text:
§ 2
Deliberate teamkilling is a permanent ban

Accidents happen and are forgiven. Say so on the radio and move on.

Repeated carelessness counts as deliberate.

entries.name: Communication
entries.title: § 3 - Radio
entries.text:
§ 3
Carry a radio and use it

Nobody has to be good at it. Everybody has to be reachable.

Keep the platoon net clear - squad chatter belongs on the squad net.

categories.name: Getting Started
categories.title: Getting Started
categories.text: The things new players ask on their first evening.

entries.name: Joining a squad
entries.title: Joining a squad
entries.text:
In three steps

Open the group menu
Pick a squad with a free slot
Set your radio to its frequency

If every squad is full, ask on the platoon net - somebody will make room.

entries.name: Reporting someone
entries.title: Reporting someone
entries.text:
Press F10 and hold Enter to send.

You can name a specific player, the one who killed you last, the one who hurt you last, or everyone nearby - the server works out who that was, so you do not have to catch a name mid-firefight.

A clip helps. A precise description helps more than an angry one.
